## What information is used now?
There are several current examples that use habitat indicators to forecast bycatch potential.  

**GF: Should the in dev tools be moved to rhs? Should something like the scup GRAs be here instead?**

[RHAPcast](https://www.rhapcast.org/index.html) uses species distribution model output and hindcast forecasts of habitat (sea surface temperature) to identify areas that maximize target species encounters while minimizing bycatch species encounters.

## Information sources for indicators

List current info sources from google doc

### Potential Indicator Sources

* DisMAP (survey data)
* NRHA data explorer (SDMs)
* MOM6 (ocean model data products)
* rhapcast
* NEFSC fishing effort footprints

[State of the Ecosystem](https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/new-england-mid-atlantic/ecosystems/state-ecosystem-reports-northeast-us-shelf) and [Risk Assessment](https://www.mafmc.org/s/2_MAB_RiskAssess_2024.pdf) indicators


### Potential Pathways
*  Evaluate measures with indicators of fishery and species spatial overlap
- Spatial distribution of fishery (confidential data, can we get it? Commercial and rec?)
- Spatial distribution of species (survey data, can we get it?)
- Spatial model 
*  Simulate distribution shifts, fleet movement constraints, etc.
*  Determine what spatial management measures meet objectives with minimal side effects?


::: {.ltpurplebox data-latex=""}
## Information gaps 

Spatial distribution of fishing effort may not be available/accessible for all sectors / fleets. Challenges of mapping fleet effort to specific species.
